post.summary: Get verdict API: independent verdict (clear / caution / block
post.description: An independent verdict (clear / caution / block / unknown) with a score from 0 to 100; higher means more caution, the reasons, the named sources and a signed receipt, for one address, contract, agent, domain or transaction. Automated screening of public lists and live providers: not legal advice; not a sanctions clearance; a screening signal for your own decision. Price: $0.02 per successful execution, paid with x402 v2 or MPP (read the 402 response: x402 accepts[] in the body, Payment challenge in WWW-Authenticate).

post.summary: Get signed receipt (genesis402-receipt-v1)
post.description: One Ed25519-signed, hash-chained receipt recording that a SHA-256 digest existed at the time of payment: either the rail hashes up to 16 KiB of text you send (OBSERVED) or you send a digest you computed (ATTESTED). The receipt binds to your payment tx, carries truth labels and limitations, and verifies offline with the open verifier at github.com/FTHTrading/402-truth. The rail stores the receipt, never your bytes. Not externally anchored yet. Price: $0.25 per successful execution, paid with x402 v2 or MPP (read the 402 response: x402 accepts[] in the body, Payment challenge in WWW-Authenticate).

post.summary: Get multi-chain EVM balance read - native + ERC20, up to 5
post.description: Native and ERC20 balances for ONE address across up to five EVM chains (Ethereum, Base, Polygon, Arbitrum, Optimism) in a single paid call, with up to 10 token contracts per request. Each chain names the RPC endpoint that actually answered, and each token reports symbol, decimals, the raw integer and the decimal-adjusted balance. A chain whose RPC does not answer is reported available:false with the reason - never as a zero balance. An address with no ERC20 at it on a given chain is reported as such, not as a zero. Every chain is tried against a list of public endpoints so one node rate-limiting us does not cost the buyer their call. Price: $0.008 per successful execution, paid with x402 v2 or MPP (read the 402 response: x402 accepts[] in the body, Payment challenge in WWW-Authenticate).
